metadata.scope: Phase 44 fourth remediation; baseline 69f7462, code/test/deployment candidate 228a355, material HEAD 9c3da0b

executiveSummary.text: PASS: the remaining owner-loss Medium is closed by fail-closed pending recovery, a process-local publish guard, DML-before-window ordering, and exact 16/16 real MySQL/Redis interleavings. The four previous Low failure conditions are closed. One new non-blocking Low remains because the brownfield preflight is not wired into the authoritative release runbook and wrapper-based results lack self-identifying target markers.

dimensions.name: Security
dimensions.justification: No auth, permission, credential, or external-interface delta; read-only evidence boundaries are explicit.

dimensions.name: Stability
dimensions.justification: Owner-loss and crash recovery remain fail-closed until a bounded recovery deadline.

dimensions.name: Performance
dimensions.justification: The low-frequency write path is bounded; no multi-instance load benchmark was run.

dimensions.name: Testing
dimensions.justification: Exact 16/16 real dependency evidence, 53/53 independent offline tests, and source/XML/hash/time-chain checks agree.

dimensions.name: Maintainability
dimensions.justification: Publication guard, configuration validation, gate scripts, and rollout contract are separated clearly.

dimensions.name: Design
dimensions.justification: Process-local and Redis guards cover complementary failure modes; durable post-commit revision remains a long-term boundary.

dimensions.name: Release
dimensions.justification: Blocking findings are zero; authoritative preflight wiring and target provenance remain one Low.

topRisks.title: Brownfield preflight is not authoritative and wrapper target evidence is incomplete
topRisks.summary: The current target passed, but README and Phase 14 do not mandate the preflight and its PASS output lacks database, account, and server identity markers.

detailedFindings.title: Brownfield preflight is not authoritative and wrapper target evidence is incomplete

evidence.functionOrModule: CLI injection, read-only query, and PASS markers
evidence.relevantBehavior: The script validates check results but does not emit DATABASE(), CURRENT_USER(), or server identity, and the authoritative rollout docs do not require it.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: A future operator skips the candidate-only preflight or a wrapper connects to a different same-shaped schema and archives a green result.
detailedFindings.userVisibleImpact: Historical collisions or collation drift in the actual deployment schema can be missed.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Wire the script into Phase 14 and README, validate target markers, archive a redacted grants and cleanup summary, and add pure-stub negative tests.
detailedFindings.betterLongTermFix: Generate a signed pre-deploy artifact containing candidate SHA, target instance ID, schema, redacted principal, and structured results.
detailedFindings.regressionTestSuggestion: Use offline stubs for correct target, wrong target, missing or duplicate markers, and nonzero client exit.

fixOrder.reason: It is non-blocking for this target but should be closed before stable release.

quickWins.impact: Makes future brownfield gates mandatory and independently attributable.
